# OpenDipper

> 全球开源生态观测站 / Global open-source ecosystem observatory. Monthly OpenDigger metrics, independent geographic aggregates and near-live sourced events; observed and fixed demo data remain separate.

Repository: https://github.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper
Site: https://www.x-lab.info/open-dipper/
Application version: 1.0.0; visual baseline: 1.2.0. These do not declare GitHub releases.

Discovery context, not an authorization grant. People submit needs through issues; agents lead authorized engineering work under docs/HARNESS.md. Read AGENTS.md and task-specific authoritative documents. AI-work disclosure and license limitations are in CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/RIGHTS.md. Task status lives in GitHub issues.

## Language editions

- readme (default: en): [en](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/README.md) | [zh-CN](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/README.zh-CN.md)
- contributing (default: en): [en](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) | [zh-CN](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md)

- [Execution plan lifecycle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/docs/plans/README.md): Versioned checkpoints and decisions for complex or multi-session tasks

- [Agent entry point](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/AGENTS.md): Task workflow, invariants, generated-file ownership and verification
- [Contributing and AI disclosure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Human/Agent collaboration, review expectations and attribution
- [Documentation map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/docs/README.md): Reading paths and documentation lifecycle
- [Current baseline and issues](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/docs/STATUS.md): Dated verified state, limitations and live task links
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Modules, data paths and operational boundaries
- [Visual baseline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/docs/VISUAL_SYSTEM.md): Brand, semantic colors, map/globe interaction and responsive layouts
- [Data contract map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/docs/DATA_CONTRACTS.md): Monthly, annual geography, events, demo and failure semantics

- [Geography contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/public/data/GEOGRAPHY.md): Trailing-year labels, unknown coverage and map semantics
- [Event contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/docs/EVENTS.md): Event fields, source health and independent editorial approval
- [Development](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md): Task-specific files, commands and browser reproduction
- [Operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md): Schedules, deployment, failures, review and rollback
- [Decisions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/docs/DECISIONS.md): Reference identity and architectural/product tradeoffs
- [Collaboration history](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/docs/HISTORY.md): Milestones, feedback and commit evidence
- [Product review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/docs/REVIEW.md): Manual acceptance walkthrough and display matrix
- [Maintenance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/docs/MAINTENANCE.md): Cleanup inventory, compatibility routes and generated outputs
- [Rights status](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/docs/RIGHTS.md): Separate application, data, brand and dependency terms
- [Security reports](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/SECURITY.md): Reporting without exposing secrets or exploit details
- [Handoff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/docs/templates/HANDOFF.md): Reproducible context and actual verification for the next contributor
- [Design resource usage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/X-lab2017/open-dipper/main/design/README.md): Reuse shared components, tokens and pinned brand assets
